feeds.title: Hodge Podge Hippie
feeds.description: I'm a 33 year old frugal fanatic. My family is my priority, my life. Each day I wake up, go to work and know it is for them and for us. The other part of this blog will be to show my hippie side.

feeds.title: Hippie In Heels Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rachel. I am a contradiction: part dirty hippie/part girly girl. My aim is to make travel glamorous, on a backpacking budget. I am sharing my stories to inspire you; it is possible to quit your job, travel the world, and look cute doing it. I am currently living in Goa, India.

feeds.title: High End Hippie
feeds.description: A fashion and lifestyle blog made to entertain and inspire. I'm the queen of contradictions so I felt this name kind of encompassed that. I've always been into bohemian style clothes but even when I'm not wearing something that would be portrayed as such I still bring the effortless hippie feel.

feeds.title: Hippie Fest
feeds.description: Hippie Fest is the grooviest event of the year! Featuring hundreds of vendors and artists, live entertainment, family-friendly activities and so much more!

feeds.title: Dr Robert Muller
feeds.description: Welcome to the Hippie Music and Culture site! This site looks at a whole lot of 1960s culture as well as reviewing the classic psychedelic, jazz-rock and blues inspired music of the 1960s and 1970s.

feeds.title: Hippies and Granola Yoga Blog Page - Hippies and Granola
feeds.description: Welcome to our Blog. We are constantly updating, So make sure to check back often to see our new content. Yoga Inspired content from Hippies and Granola.
